text: No, there was no confirmed tree-cover loss on this property in 2020. While the Hansen GFC dataset identified 0.7 hectares (0.02% of the asset) as potential tree-cover loss, the independent JRC 2020 reference map found no agreement with this classification. Since the corroboration rule requires at least 50% agreement from the JRC reference for an event to be validated, this claim is contradicted. The detected loss was also below the minimum event area threshold of 0.5 hectares, further invalidating it. The evidence does not establish whether any actual loss occurred or its cause, but it does not support the claim of tree-cover loss in 2020.
